std_gravity.citation: BIPM / ISO 80000-3 standard gravity, the conventional value used in the rocket equation.

codata_c.citation: CODATA / SI definition of the metre. Light time = distance / c.

tsiolkovsky.citation: Δv = Isp · g0 · ln(m0/mf). Classical. Used here with vacuum Isp planning values.

zeitlin2013_cruise.citation: Zeitlin, C. et al. Measurements of Energetic Particle Radiation in Transit to Mars on the Mars Science Laboratory. Science 340, 1080–1084 (2013). doi:10.1126/science.1235989. Tissue-equivalent dose 0.48 ± 0.08 mGy/day; dose equivalent 1.84 ± 0.30 mSv/day inside the spacecraft over ~253 days. Shortest comparable round trip 0.66 ± 0.12 Sv.

zeitlin2014_surface.citation: Zeitlin, C. et al. Mars’ Surface Radiation Environment Measured with the Mars Science Laboratory’s Curiosity Rover. Science 343, 1244797 (2014). doi:10.1126/science.1244797. First ~300 sols near solar maximum: 0.21 ± 0.04 mGy/day absorbed; 0.64 ± 0.12 mSv/day dose equivalent, on the rover deck (RTG background subtracted).

nasa_bvad_2022.citation: Ewert, M.K. et al. Life Support Baseline Values and Assumptions Document. NASA/TP-20210024855 (2022 update). Table 3-31, 82 kg crewmember, RQ 0.86, exercise included: O2 0.895 kg/CM-d, CO2 1.085 kg/CM-d, food solids 0.800 kg/CM-d, food energy 12.778 MJ/CM-d, potable water 3.217 kg/CM-d. ISS food logistics 2.39 kg/CM-d including packaging is discussed in the same section from Ewert et al. 2019.

nasa_iss_water_2023.citation: NASA. NASA Achieves Water Recovery Milestone on International Space Station (2023). Brine Processor Assembly brought total ECLSS water recovery to 98%; before BPA, about 93–94%.

nasa_eclss_o2_2021.citation: NASA life-support briefing, NTRS 20210013975 (2021). Current O2 recovery from CO2 about 47%; goal >75%. Sabatier reaction CO2 + 4 H2 → CH4 + 2 H2O is hydrogen-limited by electrolysis.

colaprete2010.citation: Colaprete, A. et al. Detection of Water in the LCROSS Ejecta Plume. Science 330, 463–468 (2010). doi:10.1126/science.1186986. Cabeus permanently shadowed crater: 5.6 ± 2.9% water ice by mass; 155 ± 12 kg water vapor and ice in the instrument field of view.

hecht2009.citation: Hecht, M.H. et al. Detection of Perchlorate and the Soluble Chemistry of Martian Soil at the Phoenix Lander Site. Science 325, 64–67 (2009). doi:10.1126/science.1172466. Perchlorate at the Phoenix site on the order of 0.4–0.6 wt%.

nasa_moxie_2023.citation: NASA. NASA’s Oxygen-Generating Experiment MOXIE Completes Mars Mission (2023). 16 runs, 122 g O2 total, peak 12 g/h, purity ≥98%. A demonstration, not a crew-scale propellant plant.

nasa_dra5_2009.citation: Drake, B.G. (ed.). Human Exploration of Mars Design Reference Architecture 5.0. NASA/SP-2009-566 (2009). Addendum NASA/SP-2009-566-ADD. Conjunction-class long-stay missions, opportunities about every 26 months / 2.1 years, 15-year synodic cycle. Example communications two-way 6–44 minutes. Moon vs Mars comparison table: Mars total mission mass ~800–1200 t, total Δv LEO to surface and back 12–14 km/s; Moon ~9.5 km/s and ~200 t. Crew of 6, surface stay on the order of 500 days, transits on the order of 180–210 days. Pre-deploy cargo one opportunity (~26 months) ahead.

borowski_ntr_2012.citation: Borowski, S.K., McCurdy, D.R., Packard, T.W. Nuclear Thermal Rocket/Vehicle Characteristics and Sensitivity Trades for NASA’s Mars DRA 5.0. NASA NTRS 20120012928. NERVA-derived NTR Isp ~900–910 s. Cargo vehicles on minimum-energy paths; crewed vehicle on a faster conjunction trajectory.

nssdc_mars_factsheet.citation: NASA Goddard NSSDC Mars Fact Sheet. Surface pressure ~6.36 mb (variable), CO2 95.32%, N2 2.7%, Ar 1.6%, O2 0.13%, CO 0.08%. Mean temperature ~210 K. Surface gravity 3.71 m/s^2. Sidereal orbit 686.98 d. Semi-major axis 1.5237 AU.

nssdc_moon_factsheet.citation: NASA Goddard NSSDC Moon Fact Sheet. Surface gravity 1.62 m/s^2. Mean distance 384,400 km. Sidereal month 27.3 d; synodic month ~29.5 d so a lunar night is ~14.8 d away from the poles.

braun_manning_2007.citation: Braun, R.D. and Manning, R.M. Mars Exploration Entry, Descent, and Landing Challenges. Journal of Spacecraft and Rockets 44(2), 310–323 (2007). doi:10.2514/1.25116. Heritage landed mass is about one tonne. Human-scale landers (tens of tonnes) need supersonic retropropulsion or other new EDL and are not demonstrated.

severinghaus1994_biosphere2.citation: Severinghaus, J.P. et al. Oxygen loss in Biosphere 2. Eos, Transactions AGU 75(3), 33–37 (1994). doi:10.1029/94EO00285. Closed ecological systems can drift: O2 fell from ~20.9% toward ~14.5% as unaccounted respiration and CO2 uptake (including structural concrete) unbalanced the air. Social fracture accompanied the physical one.

esa_mars500.citation: IBMP / ESA Mars-500 (2010–2011), 520-day isolation study with a 6-person crew. Psychology and operations analog, not a closed ecological life-support closure test.

nasa_std_3001.citation: NASA Spaceflight Human-System Standard NASA-STD-3001. Career radiation control is framed as risk of exposure-induced death (REID), historically a 3% REID criterion at high confidence, and is age- and sex-specific. It is not a single sievert number. The game’s 600 mSv dose-equivalent planning cap is a conservative operational screen, marked as an estimate, not a quotation of the standard.

icrp103.citation: ICRP Publication 103 (2007). Planned occupational exposure is typically managed around 20 mSv/year averaged over 5 years (not more than 50 mSv in a single year). Using 20 mSv/year as a permanent-settlement design target is a game analogy, not a spaceflight rule and not a claim that ICRP certifies planetary habitats.

smith2014.short: Genetic census for a new world
smith2014.citation: Smith, C.M. Estimation of a genetically viable population for multigenerational interstellar voyaging: Review and data for world ships. Acta Astronautica 97, 16–29 (2014). doi:10.1016/j.actaastro.2013.12.013. Order-of-magnitude census runs to the tens of thousands without a germplasm bank. A hundred living people are an engineering seed only if a large archive travels with them.

spacex_falcon_heavy.citation: SpaceX public Falcon Heavy capability figures widely published in the early 2020s: about 63,800 kg to LEO expendable, 26,700 kg to GTO, 16,800 kg to Mars. Commercial claims change. The game’s purchasable ‘heavy’ class is deliberately lower and is an estimate of what a program can repeatedly buy, not a quote of one rocket.

nasa_sls.citation: NASA Space Launch System reference figures: Block 1 on the order of 95 t to LEO and about 27 t to trans-lunar injection. Cadence and cost are not those of a commercial medium launcher. NASA OIG has reported multi-billion-dollar per-flight costs; the game does not treat that as the only price of heavy lift.

nasa_kilopower.citation: NASA Kilopower project and the KRUSTY ground test: fission power in the roughly 1–10 kWe class aimed at Moon and Mars surface systems. A crew settlement’s grow-lights need megawatts; kilowatts keep robots and storm survival alive.

jonsson2008_tardigrade.short: Tardigrades survive exposure, they do not colonize
jonsson2008_tardigrade.citation: Jönsson, K.I. et al. Tardigrades survive exposure to space in low Earth orbit. Current Biology 18(17), R729–R731 (2008). doi:10.1016/j.cub.2008.06.048. Vacuum and radiation survival on FOTON-M3. Survival of a dormant animal is not an ecosystem.

sancho2007_lichen.citation: Sancho, L.G. et al. Lichens survive in space: results from the 2005 LICHENS experiment. Astrobiology 7(3), 443–454 (2007). doi:10.1089/ast.2006.0046. Exposure survival again, not growth of a biosphere. On Mars, UV, desiccation, and perchlorates still block open-air establishment.

lenski_travisano_1994.short: 10,000 generations of E. coli, not 10,000 years
lenski_travisano_1994.citation: Lenski, R.E. and Travisano, M. Dynamics of adaptation and diversification: a 10,000-generation experiment with bacterial populations. PNAS 91(15), 6808–6814 (1994). doi:10.1073/pnas.91.15.6808. Adaptation and divergence in the early long-term evolution experiment. At several generations per day, 10,000 generations are a few years of culture. The game cites this so the 10,000-year tier is not mistaken for it.

hendry2007_speciation.short: Ecological speciation has no single clock
hendry2007_speciation.citation: Hendry, A.P., Nosil, P. and Rieseberg, L.H. The speed of ecological speciation. Functional Ecology 21(3), 455–464 (2007). doi:10.1111/j.1365-2435.2007.01240.x. Some ecological speciation is a few hundred generations; many animal lineages are closer to a million years. The game's 10,000-year tier is an estimate at the low end of the owner's deep-time ask, not a number from this paper and not a promise that a moss becomes a new species on schedule.

nasa_cp2255_1982.short: 1980 NASA study of a self-replicating lunar factory
nasa_cp2255_1982.citation: Freitas, R.A. Jr. and Gilbreath, W.P. (eds). Advanced Automation for Space Missions. NASA Conference Publication 2255 (1982). Proceedings of the 1980 NASA/ASEE summer study on self-replicating lunar manufacturing. A concept study. The factory was not built. This game does not reproduce its design or a construction procedure. The 50-year machine tier and the metal rate are estimates anchored to the idea of local feedstock, repair, and growth.

von_neumann_1966.citation: von Neumann, J. Theory of Self-Reproducing Automata. Edited and completed by A.W. Burks. University of Illinois Press (1966). A theoretical model of a machine that can copy itself, including the idea that the copy must be reliable enough to keep the description intact. Not a probe, not a lunar factory, and not a measured error rate. The game's fidelity floor is an estimate in that spirit.

cospar_planetary_protection.citation: COSPAR Policy on Planetary Protection. Mars missions are typically Category IV; missions that can reach special regions are more stringent. The policy limits forward contamination of other worlds. It does not describe how to release organisms, and this game does not either. The political cost of a sealed off-world culture is an estimate of that constraint.

game_calibration.citation: Where a single published number does not exist (shielding transmission curve, farm lighting power, IMLEO campaign splits, dramatic solar-particle odds, ascent-propellant threshold), the value is an order-of-magnitude estimate anchored to the cited literature. Estimates are flagged estimate=true and must be spoken as estimates.
